# RFC 9421, HTTP Message Signatures, Appendix B.1.1 "Example RSA Key" (test-key-rsa: a 2048-bit key,
# its public half a PKCS#1 "RSA PUBLIC KEY" PEM) and the public half of B.1.2 "Example RSA-PSS Key"
# (test-key-rsa-pss: an SPKI "PUBLIC KEY" PEM). Read on 12 November 2026 from
# https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9421 (the copy downloaded that day). Copied as printed.
# test-key-rsa signs 4.3's proxy_sig with rsa-v1_5-sha256. test-key-rsa-pss is used by the tests only
# to show that the signature bases of 2.5 and B.2.1 to B.2.3 were copied exactly, by checking the
# RFC's RSA-PSS signatures over them; Flowa itself never verifies RSA-PSS.
